question_text: What comes next in the pattern: 1A, 2B, 3C, 4D, ___?

hint_ladder.title: Look at the Numbers First
hint_ladder.text: Pansinin mo ang numbers: 1, 2, 3, 4. Nagda-dagdag lang ng isa. Ano susunod sa 4? 5, siyempre.

hint_ladder.title: Now Look at the Letters
hint_ladder.text: Letters move A, B, C, D — pasulong din ng isa. After D, anong letra? Edi E.

hint_ladder.title: Put Them Together
hint_ladder.text: Pagsamahin mo: number na nakuha mo (5) at letter (E). Yan ang next term—5E.

hint_ladder.title: Check Your Answer Against the Options
hint_ladder.text: Hanapin mo sa choices ang 5E. Wala nang iba, yun ang sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you got 5 right, pero the letter should advance to E, hindi stuck sa D.

B.text: Correct. Binantayan mo pareho: number 5, letter E—isa-isa lang, walang laktaw.

C.text: You might have chosen C because E is correct, but nagmadali ka—dinagdagan mo ng 2 imbes na 1 ang number.

D.text: You might have chosen D because E is correct, pero nakalimutan mong dapat tumaas din ang number mula 4.

next_time_rule: Treat numbers and letters like separate jeepney tracks. Each moves one step. Check them separately, huwag pagsabayin.
deconstruct_text:
Imagine logging sari-sari store items: 1 Ampalaya, 2 Bawang, 3 Calamansi… Numbers increase by 1, letters follow alphabet. After 4D (Dahon?), the 5th item is 5E. Palengke-style counting.

Pero huwag kalimutan: hiwalay ang daloy ng number at letter, parang jeepney route number at plate ending. Check mo isa-isa para hindi malito.
